basis: Observed complete desktop, portrait and landscape Discovery forward/reverse videos, telemetry and safety samples. Targets are fresh-pass capture cues.

milestones.label: M01
milestones.observedChange: The concrete ground group lands and the first timber level is highlighted while the upper stack remains apart.

milestones.label: M02
milestones.observedChange: The second authored timber level closes its vertical gap with the lower stack.

milestones.label: M03
milestones.observedChange: The furnished third level settles toward its base while its desks and columns stay attached.

milestones.label: M04
milestones.observedChange: The lower levels now read as one stack, with the fourth level and roof visibly held above the furnished studio.

milestones.label: M05
milestones.observedChange: The camera leaves the axon and dives toward the exposed studio gap below the suspended upper level.

milestones.label: M06
milestones.observedChange: The camera reaches eye level among the third-level desks and columns while the upper soffit still hangs above.

milestones.label: M07
milestones.observedChange: The highlighted level-four soffit descends toward the same columns over the occupied studio.

milestones.label: M08
milestones.observedChange: The overhead gap closes into a ceiling over the same third-level workspace.

milestones.label: M09
milestones.observedChange: The camera traverses the now enclosed timber studio, preserving the column grid, desks and facade relation.

reverseSemanticStates: Discovery reverse shows the studio traverse, overhead reopening and levels separating again; no independent reverse-only state established.
